_comment: Personal settings never overwritten by apply_config / apply-offline. EXCLUSION list: everything else is imported (including new keys from the dev branch). 'keys' = {key: why it is personal} (a plain list also works). 'groups' = group names in SETTINGS_LAYOUT_DATA (Settings tab). 'patterns' = case-sensitive fnmatch patterns. 'force_include' wins over everything (e.g. UseReferenceExclusivePathToggle is a denoiser setting, not a path).

keys.ProvidersPrioritySelection: execution provider (CUDA / TensorRT / CPU) depends on this machine's GPU and install
keys.nThreadsSlider: thread count is tuned to this machine's hardware
keys.nStreamSlider: CUDA stream count is tuned to this GPU's VRAM
keys.FrameWorkerDelayDecimalSlider: frame worker timing is tuned to this machine's speed
keys.OpenOutputToggle: UI preference of this user (opens the output folder after recording)
keys.MaxDFMModelsSlider: VRAM budget for DFM models on this GPU
keys.KeepModelsAliveToggle: memory management choice for this machine's VRAM
keys.ReferenceKVTensorsSelection: selected K/V map file: embeddings data is reserved to the user
